lines.zh: 我贴着沼泽的泥滑过去。
lines.en: I glide over the swamp mud.

lines.zh: 背脊上的疙瘩刮过树根。
lines.en: The bumps on my back scrape the roots.

lines.zh: 水是褐色的，我几乎看不见。
lines.en: The water is brown; I can barely see.
One sweep of my body lifts the mud.

lines.zh: 前面三个人影，我们是一群。
lines.en: Three shadows ahead; we are a group.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，钻过倒木下面。
lines.en: I flatten and slip beneath the fallen log.

lines.zh: 这边水浅，我的背露出一点。
lines.en: The water is shallow; a bit of my back shows.

lines.zh: 我滑得慢，这样不惊动泥。
lines.en: I glide slowly so the mud stays quiet.

lines.zh: 我的皮粗得像一张砂纸。
lines.en: My skin is coarse as sandpaper.
I follow the channel toward deeper water.

lines.zh: 水草在水下缠住我的鳍。
lines.en: Underwater weeds snag my fins.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，绕过石头。
lines.en: I turn my body sideways around a stone.
Insects are crying above the swamp.

lines.zh: 我们不散开，三条一起走。
lines.en: We do not scatter; the three of us move together.

lines.zh: 泥里冒出一串泡，我绕开。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from the mud; I steer around them.

lines.zh: 我贴着倒木的阴影，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I hug the shadow of the fallen log and creep.

lines.zh: 我半埋在泥里，只露出眼。
lines.en: I lie half-buried, only my eyes showing.
Mud slowly covers my back.
I wait for a shrimp to swim too near.

lines.zh: 水面上的落叶转了一圈。
lines.en: A leaf on the surface spins once.
My breathing makes small bubbles in the mud.

lines.zh: 褐色的水让一切都变慢。
lines.en: Brown water makes everything slow.
The bumps on my back give me away.

lines.zh: 没有别的声音，只有滴水。
lines.en: No sound but dripping.

lines.zh: 我不需要掉什么东西给人。
lines.en: I leave nothing behind for anyone.
I shift, searching softer mud.

lines.zh: 有东西从我上方游过去。
lines.en: Something swims past above me.

lines.zh: 我把自己压得更平一些。
lines.en: I press myself flatter.
The swamp smells of rot and iron.
When it darkens, I will move.

lines.zh: 你站在齐膝的水里看我。
lines.en: You stand knee-deep and look at me.
I lift the front of my body out of the mud.

lines.zh: 我的眼在背上，只能往上看。
lines.en: My eyes sit on my back; I can only look up.
You cannot name me, can you.

lines.zh: 我趴在泥上，影子摊得很开。
lines.en: I lie on the mud, my shadow spread wide.

lines.zh: 你踩浑了水，我看不清你。
lines.en: You muddy the water; I cannot see you.

lines.zh: 我背上的疙瘩你数过吗？
lines.en: Have you counted the bumps on my back?
I do not flee; fleeing would not help.

lines.zh: 你把网收在身后，我看见了。
lines.en: You keep the net behind you; I saw it.

lines.zh: 再站一会儿，我就沉下去。
lines.en: Stand there a while longer and I will sink.
Blood does not show in brown water.
A cut opens across my back.
I bore into the mud, but not deep enough.
The pain makes my tail flail.
I lie still against the bottom.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍在我硬的背上。
lines.en: The blade lands on my hard back.
My fin is split; I swim unsteadily.
The blood smell draws other fish.

lines.zh: 我肚皮朝上，扑腾着翻正。
lines.en: Belly up, I thrash myself right again.
No one in the swamp shields me.
Is that a worm in your hand?
The smell in the mud has changed.
I lift my head, my mouth above the mud.
I am not picky; I take anything alive.

lines.zh: 你的手指在水里动了一下。
lines.en: Your fingers move once in the water.
I slide forward half a body-length.
This smell is not from the swamp.
I open my mouth; mud falls out.
Stay still and I come closer.
If I cannot reach it, I sink back.

lines.zh: 你踢到我的背，脚底一麻。
lines.en: You kick my back; your sole numbs.
The impact slides me two feet.
Mud blinds me at once.

lines.zh: 你的腿撞上我粗糙的背。
lines.en: Your leg scrapes my rough back.
I bounce up, then drop back into mud.
The water churns until nothing is visible.

lines.zh: 我贴住木头，稳住了身子。
lines.en: I press against a log and steady myself.
Do not shove; the skin on my back tears.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，各自退开。
lines.en: We bump once and both back away.
My whole shape is pressed into the mud.
It lifts its eyes from the mud to me.

lines.zh: 我们两条并排伏在泥上。
lines.en: The two of us lie side by side on the mud.
I touch its ridged back with a fin.
We press a hollow into the mud.

lines.zh: 第三条在旁边绕着我们走。
lines.en: The third one circles around us.
Two fish lie still; even the mud is still.

lines.zh: 它的疙瘩比我的细一点。
lines.en: Its bumps are finer than mine.
The eggs will sink into the mud unseen.
When the water falls, this place will dry.
We will guard a while longer, then go.

lines.zh: 网兜一收，我就被提起来。
lines.en: The net closes and I am lifted.
Out of the mud, my body feels heavy.
I twist in the net; my fins catch.

lines.zh: 桶里的水盖不住我的背。
lines.en: The bucket water will not cover my back.

lines.zh: 我的背擦着桶壁，沙沙响。
lines.en: My back rasps against the bucket wall.

lines.zh: 你要把我放到别的沼泽？
lines.en: Are you moving me to another swamp?
I hold still; my gills open and shut.
This water has no smell of rotting leaves.
Do not leave me on dry ground.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来，也会被带走。
lines.en: I came from an egg; I can be carried off too.
The water moves, but not from weeds.

lines.zh: 脚步的震动从泥里传过来。
lines.en: Footsteps travel to me through the mud.
I raise my eyes, showing only eyes.

lines.zh: 有东西踩着浅水走过来了。
lines.en: Something is wading through the shallows.
The water clouds; it stirred that.
I stop; my fins no longer sweep.
That sound is heavier than a frog.
I press my body down into the mud.

lines.zh: 它没看见我，我在它脚边。
lines.en: It has not seen me; I am by its feet.
When it passes, I will move.

lines.zh: 我顺着它的影子滑过去。
lines.en: I glide along its shadow.
The mud makes no sound beneath me.
The mud its feet stir hides it from me.
Half a body-length left.
I bury my snout in the soft mud.

lines.zh: 它的脚一停，我的鳍就收。
lines.en: Its foot stops; my fins fold in.
In swamp fights, whoever moves first loses.
My fins skim the mud.
It bends down; perfect.
I tense my whole body.
I sweep my tail at its ankle.
The blow lands soft and weak.
I rub my rough back against it.
Mud splashes all over it.
It retreats; I sink at once.
I have no teeth, so I only ram.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我自己弹开了。
lines.en: The ram bounces me away.
Fast in water, finished on land.
If it steps on me, I cling to the mud.
Wounded, I swim in crooked lines.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的浅水里出现。
lines.en: I appear in the swamp's shallows.
The mud is warm; the water brown.
Two of my kind are nearby.

lines.zh: 我的背一露出来就沾泥。
lines.en: My back muddies as soon as it shows.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开，我落在浅水里。
lines.en: The spawn egg cracks; I land in the shallows.
Reed shadows lie on the water.

lines.zh: 我先埋进泥里，再想别的。
lines.en: First I bury myself, then think.
The water here rises and falls.
I spread my fins and test the water.
The swamp has taken me in.

lines.zh: 热水烫着我的背，我往下沉。
lines.en: Hot water scalds my back; I sink.

lines.zh: 摔在硬地上，肚皮贴不住。
lines.en: Dropped on hard ground, my belly cannot cling.

lines.zh: 我明明泡在水里，却喘不上气。
lines.en: Soaked in water, yet I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 冲击把我从泥里掀了出来。
lines.en: The blast tears me out of the mud.

lines.zh: 箭穿过水，卡进我的背脊。
lines.en: An arrow crosses the water into my back.

lines.zh: 光打下来，我的眼一阵发白。
lines.en: Light strikes; my eyes white out.

lines.zh: 泥里没有虾了，我越来越薄。
lines.en: No shrimp left in the mud; I grow thin.

lines.zh: 雷打进沼泽，我的鳍都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the swamp; my fins go numb.

lines.zh: 往下掉时，连泥也没有了。
lines.en: Falling, even the mud is gone.
